changeRecord.title: sections swapped between two members
changeRecord.whyItMatters: Each member was sized for its own forces. With the sections exchanged (a beam section on a column, the upper-storey column size at the base) one member is under-sized and the other over-sized; the stiffness distribution of the frame changes with them, and so do the forces every member attracts.
